items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: And I stayed with Ory up until 1953.

ctx.x: Yeah, I still played it. But I never played any more alto.
Well, after that, I came back to Los Angeles here and went back with Ory. See, now I'm talking about 1948 or '49.
That was when Blakeney was with the band.

items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: My client had to go to Seattle, Joe, Dennisburg, you know?

ctx.x: There was a Columbia recording. Uh-huh. Well, I asked you the other night on the phone about Wade Whaley. You think he's in San Diego. Do you? Where did you see him last?
Last time I saw him there, in 45, I was working at the Jade Room. My client had to go to Seattle, Joe, Dennisburg, you know?
